subject: EOQ: Practical annotated vignettes for comms and contested scores
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Sun <amelia@optera.io>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ: Practical annotated vignettes for comms and contested scores

Team — attaching a compact packet of annotated vignettes and the latest score table for the end-of-quarter materials we'll share with execs and the Partner Ops team. The intent here is twofold: (1) give the QBR and product teams concise, example-based stories they can copy into slides and PRDs; (2) transparently document borderline scoring decisions so leadership can adjudicate final marks.

High level:
- Attached: vignettes_q3_evidence.pdf (6 pages of short customer vignettes with metrics) and okr_score_table.csv (per-objective raw evidence and proposed scores).
- I flagged four items in the CSV as "contested" — rows C3, D1, D4, E2. Short rationale in the comments column.
- For comms, the narrative we use should include a one-line rating justification and one line of mitigations / next steps (e.g., "Down 1pt due to delayed rollout; mitigation: prioritize hotfix and canary next week").

Asks:
1) Vivek: can you confirm any governance-level adjustments for scoring rules we must apply (e.g., threshold for partial credit on adoption KR)? I want any adjustments before I finalize the vignettes.
2) Marissa: please confirm the customer metric cited in vignette #2 (Optera) matches the customer-metrics-log.xlsx I referenced — I left a note where the telemetry shows a 9% drop in conversion vs. target.
3) Laura: are you comfortable with the wording in the sample exec note on page 2 of the PDF? If not, please suggest edits — we want to avoid surprises in the QBR deck.

I'll incorporate changes by EOD Monday and push the version to the shared Drive link and to the comms owner. If any of you want to escalate a contested mark to the scoring panel, flag it in your reply with the reason.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: vignettes_q3_evidence.pdf (pdf), okr_score_table.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: Practical annotated vignettes for comms and contested scores

Irene — thanks for the packet, looks tight and very usable for comms. Quick notes: 

- Governance: we should apply the recent guidance from the scoring rubric (May 2027 update) that caps partial credit on adoption KRs at 0.5 when cohort adoption is <50% but trending. That will affect row D1.
- For contested rows: I think C3 and D4 are resolvable within product data; D1 looks like it needs escalation (metrics borderline + customer feedback that suggests broader adoption issues).

Marissa — can you pull the telemetry and confirm the cohort split for D1? If we escalate, I'll loop in Product Ops and ask them to present the raw dashboard (INF-9876).

If no objection from Laura, I'll mark C3 and D4 as "uphold" and escalate D1 to the scoring panel. Tagging Amelia since Optera is in the vignette and she'll want to confirm the customer context.

— Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Amelia Sun <amelia@optera.io>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: Practical annotated vignettes for comms and contested scores

Folks — I pulled the logs and attached a quick extract (customer-metrics-log.xlsx). Short findings:

- D1 (Optera adoption KR): the cohort breakdown shows ~42% active usage in the pilot window, but a strong skew to two accounts. The 9% drop Irene called out is correct for the cohort mean; median looks stable. My recommendation: downgrade D1 by 0.5 (from 3.0 to 2.5 on our 4-point scale) rather than a full point because the signal is mixed.
- C3: the feature parity issue was user-triggered; support cases show no systemic regressions. I support marking C3 as upheld.
- D4: rollout delay was due to infra flakiness; we've scheduled the hotfix next week — recommend we mark as a 0.5 markdown with mitigation note.

If Vivek wants to escalate D1, I can prepare a 2-slide packet for the scoring panel showing the cohort distribution + raw query. Otherwise I will update the CSV and push a v1.1 to the Drive.

Attachment stub: customer-metrics-log.xlsx (xlsx)

—Marissa

On Sun, Aug 1, 2027 at 11:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene — thanks for the packet, looks tight and very usable for comms. Quick notes...

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Sun <amelia@optera.io>, Aaron Li <aaron.procure@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: Practical annotated vignettes for comms and contested scores

Thanks all — this is extremely helpful. A few quick decisions from my side so we can finalize the QBR deck: 

1) Apply the rubric cap Vivek mentioned for D1 and adopt Marissa's recommendation: downgrade D1 by 0.5 (2.5) and include a short mitigation bullet for the next quarter. No panel escalation required.
2) C3 and D4: upheld with the mitigation and hotfix timeline noted in the vignette.
3) Comms wording: Irene, I edited the suggested exec note for clarity — please incorporate my one-line edits on page 2 (I used plain language: "Adoption mixed; ongoing remediation underway").

Next steps (owners):
- Irene: finalize vignettes + score table and upload v1.1 to Drive by EOD Monday (owner: Irene).
- Marissa: upload the customer-metrics-log.xlsx and add the cohort chart to the Drive folder (owner: Marissa).
- Vivek: confirm the rubric clause is documented in the scoring appendix (owner: Vivek).
- Laura: I'll fold the finalized one-liners into the QBR slide pack and send to Comms (owner: Laura).

I'll also copy Aaron from Procurement to surface the evidence for contract renewal conversations (he may request an addendum on adoption language).

Approved — please proceed.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff, Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
